std::quantum::join;\n\n/// Apply F4: |x> maps to sum_y exp(2*pi*i*x*y/4)|y>/2 for every input.\n/// The leftmost bit has weight 1; output reversal is part of the exact unitary.\n/// Consume and return both owners without measurement or auxiliary allocation.\npub fn qft2(q: Q<(Bit, Bit)>) -> Q<(Bit, Bit)> {\n    let (a, b) = split(q);\n    let b = h(b);\n    let (a, b) = qif(a, b) { 0 => id, 1 => s };\n    let a = h(a);\n    join(b, a)\n}\n\n/// Apply F8: |x> maps to sum_y exp(2*pi*i*x*y/8)|y>/sqrt(8) for every input.\n/// For input ((a,b),c), x = a + 2*b + 4*c; output reversal is included.\n/// Consume and return all three owners with no measurement or auxiliary.\npub fn qft3(q: Q<((Bit, Bit), Bit)>) -> Q<((Bit, Bit), Bit)> {\n    let (ab, c) = split(q);\n    let (a, b) = split(ab);\n    let
